**Coaching Note (for a club player):**

After Qg7+, Black's king is forced to e8—it cannot go to f8, d8, or d7 (all controlled by your queen). Your queen's powerful position on g7 then allows your bishop to deliver mate on g6, as the king has nowhere to run. The lesson: when your queen penetrates into the enemy kingside with check, look for quiet moves like bishop moves that deliver mate on the next turn. Your queen controls the escape squares while supporting the killer blow.
